The manifest pins every sync-managed change between cursor/plugins
`1dcc2bacde73ddd284803b7af28164d0436198fc` and
`dbf49813a39c1a5389c5e28cb8e4c1c2379e2454` (pstack 0.15.23).
Codex files come from `fb391e51376feeb4a293a213d40b8f54e19fde17`, the

The existing fixture helper checks hashes and modes and constructs local Git

without updating the adaptation registry; changed host policy must still block.
